viewerQuestion: Same price, different parts. What does this comparison page actually settle?
viewerTakeaway: I committed to an answer, then found out the page could not settle it, so I know to decide on something else.

beats.narration: Same price, different parts. Before you scroll, say out loud which side you expect this page to favour.
Hold that answer. The point is not whether you were right. It is what this page can and cannot settle for you.
On this comparison every per-game difference is smaller than the range SpecSmith's model declares for its own estimates, so the model does not separate them on frame rate. These are model estimates.
beats.onScreenText: The gaps sit inside the model's own range

beats.narration: So whichever side you picked, this page did not settle it. That is a real result, not a missing feature.
